messages:
sam: starting v2 canary in eu-west-1 for /v2/text-gen at 5% traffic. monitoring errors and 95p latency for 30m. tag: deploy/2250001234

deploy-bot: Deploy starting: canary | service=api-gateway | image=api:v2.1.0-canary | rollout=5% | id=deploy-2250001234

liz: heads-up — mobile SDK 2.0 still pins header 'x-client-api: v1' for legacy clients. need to ensure header fallback or we'll see mobile errors.

harry: noted. gateway shim pushed to map legacy header to v2 compatibility mode. quick test: ```curl -H 'x-client-api: v1' http://localhost:8080/v2/text-gen``` returns 200 with compatibility layer

emily: observability: dashboards added: api/v2/canary/errors, api/v2/canary/latency. alerts: error-rate >1% sustained 5m, 95p latency >300ms. also added eval set "smoke-v1->v2" to detect schema/regression diffs.

sam: rollforward plan: 10m baseline then decision. also check embeddings route — there was a float32->float16 contract change that can break older clients. @devops confirm router fallback behavior on model signature mismatch.

devops: confirmed — router falls back to v1 when model signature mismatch detected. metric router.fallback.count added and tagged as fallthrough:v1 for visibility.

liz: can we add a note to rollout doc about regenerating mobile tokens? mobile team may need a tiny patch. prefer delaying full shift until SDK 2.1 GA.

sam: agreed. staged plan: 5% canary -> 30% after 1h if stable -> 100% after SDK 2.1 GA + no regressions. rollback criteria: >1% client errors (5xx) from canary region, or 95p latency >50% vs baseline, or >10 eval regressions.

deploy-bot: Canary update (10m): no alerts. metrics: errors=0.12% , 95p=210ms.

harry: spotted a spike from edge eu-north-1 at t+7m — logs show schema_validation_failed on embedding request from client old-embed-sdk/1.8

emily: adding client.version tag to telemetry so we can filter and quantify old-sdk impact.

sam: decision: continue canary but pin /mobile/v1 routes to v1 for 72h while SDK uptake tracked. will announce in release notes and partner comms.

liz: I'll draft release notes and include operator rollback steps and header pin examples (how to force v1): `X-Redwood-Prefer-Version: v1`

deploy-bot: Canary snapshot saved: snapshot_id=canary-2250001234-1. rollback command: `deploy rollback snapshot canary-2250001234-1 --scope canary`

sam: pinging product PMs for partner comms @ana

ana: got it. I'll prepare partner email + webhook notification for integrators when SDK 2.1 beta is available.

harry: action items: 1) gateway header mapping patch (done) 2) telemetry for old SDK (in progress) 3) docs: header pin + operator pin guide. ETA 2h.

deploy-bot: Canary checkpoint: 45m elapsed. metrics stable. next automated check-in at +1h.
